description: This photograph displays a panoramic view of a wide estuary or bay, integrating urban development, transport infrastructure, and marine aquaculture. In the foreground, a densely built-up residential area covers the right-hand hillside, featuring numerous houses and buildings. At the base of this hillside, a complex multi-level highway interchange with several ramps is visible. The central area of the image is occupied by a large expanse of blue water, dotted with numerous grid-like aquaculture rafts, likely mussel farms, and a single white sailboat. A small port or marina structure is also present along the urbanized shoreline. Across the estuary, another urbanized coastal strip can be seen, along with a prominent white suspension bridge that spans a narrower section of the waterway. The background is composed of undulating hills and mountains, partially vegetated, set against a clear blue sky.
